package design

import . "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/dsl"

var _ = Service("svc", func() {

	Method("send", func() {

		Payload(func() {

			Field(1, "small", Int32, func() {
				Example(int32(2147483647))
			})
			Field(2, "big", Int64, func() {
				Example(int64(9223372036854775807))
			})
			Required("small", "big")

		})
		GRPC(func() {

		})

	})

})
